short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1208 recent saved-signal files and 322 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @Vinex_Tech: How is it possible that this much of ear wax is in grandpas ear? and @RBLabQ: midjourneyのクレジットが尽きてしまい、他の画像生成モデルを色々触っていたんですが、 Recraft v4なかなか面白いです🤩 Freepikで生成しています🎯, plus 7 more. A source image from i0.wp.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from Dither Boy - Studio AAA Advanced Image Dithering App.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-30. Use architectural section with architectural section; make A large black negative-space void should dominate the upper and outer field, with the active source structures compressed into a strong central horizontal band rather than filling the whole canvas. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against upper-left glowing vertical slit, central tall white aperture seam, and upper-right six-pinhole cluster.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
